caption: The drawing features three objects arranged on a light beige background. At the center bottom, there is a vertically positioned object composed of an oval or nearly rectangular base with two long, straight rods extending upward from its top. The base appears solid and slightly rounded at the corners, and the rods are slender and parallel, reaching about two-thirds up the image. To the left and right sides of the central object are two similarly shaped flat items, both horizontally oriented and resembling flattened ovals. Each of these side objects displays symmetrical decorative patterns, with a central circle or disc containing smaller geometric designs and surrounded by additional linear motifs. The color of all objects is a muted grayish tone, rendered in pencil or graphite, and the decorative details are moderately darker than the background. The overall composition places the main rod-and-base object in the center, flanked by the two flatter and decorated items.
title: Wafer Irons
